properties.name: WBCBR15
properties.notes: This site is an Area of Change in the current Core Strategy (AOC4). The whole site is now owned by the Council. The site could deliver a mixed use development comprising residential, commercial and leisure uses. This site is an Area of Change in the adopted Core Strategy and a proposed allocation in the Submision Draft Worthing Local Plan with a minimum delivery of 150 dwellings. It is also a 'Potential' SHLAA site.. SHLAA Ref: WB08042
